hints.title: Right-to-Left Traversal Order
hints.text: The invalid node has a right child pointing to another node on its right at the same level.

hints.title: Traversing Right Before Left
hints.text: In BFS or DFS, process right children before left children so that nodes on the right are registered first.

hints.title: Detecting Invalid Cross Link
hints.text: If a node right child was already visited during this traversal, the current node is defective and must be pruned by returning null.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in binary tree
complexity.notes: Visits each node once in right-to-left DFS, recording seen nodes in a set.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Left-to-right search encounters the defective node before the target node on the right has been seen.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Right-to-left visitation guarantees the target node is present in the visited set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Right-to-left traversal order with visited set to prune the erroneous branch.
